help.title: Help is here
help.emergency: If you are in danger or might hurt yourself, contact your local emergency services now.
help.crisis: You don't have to face this alone. If you might hurt yourself, or someone may have taken too much, call emergency services or a helpline below now.
help.notSetUp: Help contacts have not been set up yet.
help.callHint: Opens your phone app with this number
help.unverified: Not yet checked. Please confirm this number before relying on it.
help.stale: Last checked more than 6 months ago ({{date}}). It may be out of date.

home.title: Welcome, {{nickname}}
home.subtitle: One step at a time. You can come back here whenever you need.

hide.buttonHint: Switches to a neutral screen straight away
hide.title: Notes

lock.title: Welcome back
lock.wrongPin: That PIN didn't match. Please try again.
lock.wait: Too many tries. Please wait {{seconds}} seconds and try again.
lock.forgotInfo: For your privacy, the PIN cannot be recovered. You can delete all data on this phone and set the app up again.
lock.blocked: For your safety, PIN entry is paused after too many tries. You can unlock with your fingerprint or face if it is turned on, or delete all data on this phone and set the app up again.

onboarding.translationNote: This text is shown in English until a reviewed translation is ready.
onboarding.nicknameHint: Any name you like. No real name needed. It stays on this phone.
onboarding.nicknameInvalid: Please enter a nickname of up to 30 characters.
onboarding.pinInfo: Your PIN keeps the app private. Use 4 to 6 digits. It cannot be recovered, so choose one you will remember.
onboarding.pinMismatch: The two PINs are different. Please try again.
onboarding.pinWeak: That PIN is easy to guess. Please avoid repeated digits, simple runs of digits, and common PINs.

settings.title: Settings
settings.shakeToHide: Shake the phone to hide the app
settings.dataInfo: Everything you enter stays on this phone, encrypted.
settings.supportInfo: Someone you trust to call when things get hard. This stays on this phone.
settings.supportInvalid: Please enter a name and a full phone number.
settings.reminder: Remind me to check in each day
settings.reminderDenied: Notifications are off for this app. You can allow them in your phone's settings.
settings.reminderPreview: The reminder will say only this:
settings.simulatedNotification: Web demo: on a phone, the reminder above would appear now.
settings.reminderAppName: Your phone also shows this app's name with each reminder, and may show it on the lock screen.

deleteAll.explain: This permanently removes everything this app stores on this phone: your nickname, PIN, settings and all entries. It cannot be undone.
deleteAll.partial: Some data could not be removed, but it is locked and can no longer be read. Please try again.
deleteAll.incomplete: Deleting did not finish, so some data may still be readable. Please try again now.

problem.title: Your data could not be opened
problem.info: The saved data on this phone could not be opened. You can delete it and set the app up again.

slowBreathing.title: Slow breathing
slowBreathing.in: Breathe in slowly through your nose.
slowBreathing.out: Breathe out gently, a little longer than you breathed in.

boxBreathing.title: Box breathing
boxBreathing.in: Breathe in for a count of four.

fiveSenses.title: Five senses
fiveSenses.see: Look around. Name five things you can see.
fiveSenses.touch: Notice four things you can feel, like your clothes or the chair.
fiveSenses.hear: Listen for three sounds, near or far.
fiveSenses.smell: Notice two things you can smell.
fiveSenses.taste: Notice one thing you can taste.

feetOnTheGround.title: Feet on the ground
feetOnTheGround.sit: Sit or stand comfortably. Let your shoulders drop.
feetOnTheGround.press: Press your feet gently into the floor. Feel it holding you up.
feetOnTheGround.hands: Rest your hands on your legs. Notice their warmth.
feetOnTheGround.name: Say quietly where you are and what day it is.

urgeSurfing.title: Ride the wave
urgeSurfing.notice: Notice the craving without fighting it. It is a feeling, and feelings change.
urgeSurfing.where: Where do you feel it in your body? Just notice.
urgeSurfing.wave: Picture it as a wave. It rises, it peaks, and then it falls.
urgeSurfing.breathe: Breathe slowly and ride the wave. You don't have to act on it.
urgeSurfing.check: How strong is it now? It may already be a little smaller.

changeTheScene.title: Change the scene
changeTheScene.move: Move to a different spot, even another room or outside.
changeTheScene.water: Drink a glass of water, slowly.
changeTheScene.task: Pick one small task: wash a cup, water a plant, or message a friend.

sos.buttonHint: Starts a short guided exercise to help you through it
sos.subtitle: A craving is a wave. Let's ride it together.
sos.title: You're not alone
sos.donePassed: You stayed with it, and it passed. Well done for riding that wave.
sos.doneNotYet: That's okay. Cravings can come in waves. You can try another exercise, reach out, or get help.
sos.doneUnsure: Thank you for checking in with yourself. Every pause like this counts.
sos.notSafe: Not safe right now, or someone may have taken too much?
sos.breathingNote: Breathe in a way that feels comfortable. Skip any step that doesn't feel right.
sos.callFailed: The call could not be started on this device. The number is {{phone}}. You can also use Get help.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.empty: Each time a craving passes, it will show here. Opening SOS is already a step.
progress.typical_one: For you, cravings have often eased within about {{count}} minute.
progress.typical_other: For you, cravings have often eased within about {{count}} minutes.

vault.title: Your reasons
vault.intro: Save what matters to you, on a good day. One will be shown to you when a craving comes.
vault.textLabel: A reason, in your own words
vault.voicePhoneOnly: Voice notes work on the phone only.
vault.micDenied: Microphone access is off. You can turn it on in your phone settings.

errors.empty: There is nothing to save yet.
errors.too_long: That is a little too long. Please keep it shorter.
errors.too_large: That file is too large. Please choose a smaller one.
errors.bad_type: That kind of file can't be saved here.
errors.full: Your reasons list is full. Delete one to add another.

checkin.title: Daily check-in
checkin.intro: Four quick taps. There are no right or wrong answers.
checkin.saveError: That didn't save. Please try again.
checkin.savedTitle: Saved. Thank you for checking in.
checkin.savedBody: Small check-ins add up. You can change today's answers any time today.
checkin.strongCraving: Cravings can feel strong, and they do pass. SOS is here if you want it.
checkin.lowMood: If today feels heavy, you don't have to carry it alone.

tags.old_routine: Saw people from my old routine

checkin.scaleHint: Swipe up or down to change.

notifications.reminderBody: How are you today? Your daily note is ready when you are.
notifications.nudgeBody: Today might be a busy one. Your plan is there if you want it.

dev.title: Developer tools
dev.info: Development builds only. Demo data is made up and marked so it can be cleared.

triggers.title: Your patterns
triggers.harderToday: Today might feel harder than usual. That's okay. It can help to keep your plan close by.
triggers.reasonsToday: From today's check-in: {{reasons}}. Things like these can make a day feel heavier.

reasons.recent_cravings: cravings over the last few days
reasons.recent_stress: stress over the last few days
reasons.tag_risky_place: being near a place that's hard for you

triggers.notReadyInfo: Patterns show up once there are enough check-ins to mean something. Keep going at your own pace.

hardestTime.morning: Most of your SOS moments were in the morning.
hardestTime.afternoon: Most of your SOS moments were in the afternoon.
hardestTime.evening: Most of your SOS moments were in the evening.
hardestTime.night: Most of your SOS moments were at night.

triggers.noPatterns: Nothing clear stands out yet. That's useful to know too.
triggers.patternSentence: In your check-ins, cravings were stronger on average {{condition}}.

conditions.tag_alone: on days you're alone a lot
conditions.tag_old_routine: after seeing people from your old routine
conditions.tag_risky_place: near places that are hard for you

triggers.chartLabel: Average craving {{condition}}: {{with}} out of 4. Other days: {{without}} out of 4.
triggers.nudgesInfo: At most one a day, before your usual harder time, never between 22:00 and 08:00. The note is worded neutrally, but someone who notices it may guess today is a harder day.
triggers.honesty: These patterns come only from your own check-ins on this phone. They show what tended to go together, not what causes what. The heads-up is a rough guess from a simple model built on made-up data. It can be wrong both ways: a hard day can come without a heads-up. If today feels hard, trust that and use your plan or the help button. This is not medical advice.
triggers.cardNote: A rough guess from a simple model. You know your day best.

plan.title: My plan
plan.intro: A few words for harder moments. Only you can see this. It stays on this phone.
plan.signsHint: What do you notice when things start getting harder?
plan.helpsHint: Things that have helped before, even small ones.
plan.peopleHint: People or services you can reach out to.
plan.saveError: That didn't save. Please try again.
plan.urgentNote: If anything you write here feels urgent, help is one tap away.
